label: Night of the Blackout
summary: Your powers showed up three weeks ago. Tonight the whole city goes dark, and every registered hero is somewhere else.
title: Night of the Blackout
description: Your powers showed up three weeks ago. Tonight the whole city loses power, every registered hero is somewhere else, and you are the only one on the block who can do anything about it.

chapterOutlines.title: Lights Out
chapterOutlines.outline: Find out what the blackout is hiding and decide whether to step in.

chapterOutlines.title: Masks On
chapterOutlines.outline: Team up, or not, with a retired hero who never really retired.

scene.location: The roof of your apartment building, the moment every light in Lumen City goes out
scene.summary: Sirens start up below. Your phone has one bar of battery and forty unread messages.

openThreads: Will anyone find out who you are?

npcs.name: Nadia Kestrel
npcs.description: Retired from heroics two years ago. Very much not retired from yelling at rookies.
abilities: Flies faster than sound, for about a minute

npcs.name: Pip Lawson
npcs.description: Runs a hero-ranking blog from his kitchen. Has no idea you have powers. Yet.
goals: Get a photo of a real hero
abilities: Knows every hero's stats by heart
